Approvals Queue

Working

This is a real workflow, not a display. Use Approve or Reject on each pending item. A paid budget line can be marked Spent only when it references an approval whose status is Approved — a Rejected approval can never unlock a spend, and every blocked attempt is written to the audit log below.

Standing rule: entries in approvals-log.csv are PROPOSED until the owner's explicit confirmation. The 300-credit micro-pilot entry (APR-001) stays pending owner confirmation — it is not treated as final approval until the owner approves it here or in his own words.

AI Agents & Production Pipeline

Spec · Phase 2 buildPartially Working

Fifteen roles, honestly divided. Manual = the operator performs the step (no genuine automation exists — e.g. Flow has no public generation API, so clips are generated by hand on the provider's site). Assisted = AI drafts or checks, the operator runs and verifies. Automated = a script does it end-to-end. Every role has a defined input, output and pass test.

#AgentModeInputOutputPass test

Editor Agent — Actual Pipeline

Manual

There is no professional editor inside this web app, and none is claimed. Editing runs on the operator's machine with real tools; this app holds the plan, the cue sheet and the QC record.

StepToolWhat happensOutput
1 · IngestFile system + logApproved clips renamed to scene/shot IDs and matched against the generation log.edit/01-ingest/
2 · AssemblyffmpegScripted concat of approved takes in shot-list order; trims taken from the edit decision list.rough-cut.mp4
3 · Fine cutCapCut Desktop (free)Manual pacing pass, transitions, reaction-shot inserts. CapCut Pro only if a needed feature is missing.fine-cut.mp4
4 · Dialogue & mixffmpeg + AudacityElevenLabs lines laid against picture; line-by-line script check (catches invented audio); SFX and licensed music mixed under dialogue.mix.wav
5 · Loudnessffmpeg loudnormNormalize to −16 LUFS (YouTube), true-peak −1 dB.Loudness report
6 · Colourffmpeg LUT / CapCutOne LUT for the whole chapter so Fast and Quality shots sit in the same world.graded cut
7 · SubtitlesSRT file + ffmpegEnglish SRT authored from the locked script, burned in or shipped as sidecar.final.srt
8 · Master exportffmpeg1080p master (upscale verified free in Flow) + archive copy of project files.exports/final-1080p.mp4

Pass test for the pipeline: a 60-second sample scene goes ingest → master with matching runtime (±0.5s), loudness report in range, and every clip traceable to a log row.

Data Vault — Security, Export & Restore

Phase 1 · LiveWorking

The fix for the old deployment plan: no private data.json snapshot is ever uploaded with the public app. This build ships with demo data only; real studio data lives in the owner's folder system and is loaded locally, in the browser, only when he chooses.

Security Model — Implemented in This Build

Working

1) The deployed app contains demo records only — no real scripts, budgets or project files. 2) Export and restore run entirely on this device; nothing is sent to a server. 3) API keys are never stored in the app, the folder system or chat — they stay in each provider's own account. 4) Paid actions are gated by the approvals workflow — no bypass. 5) All studio files use open formats (md / csv / json / mp4) so any future operator or AI can run the studio without this app.

Automatic Persistence — This Device

Working

Every change in this app — projects, characters, ledger lines, approval decisions, audit entries — is saved automatically to this browser's local storage the moment it happens, and restored when the page is reopened or refreshed. Refresh test: add a record, reload the page — it is still here.

Saved locally · device only · not encrypted. Local storage belongs to this browser on this device. It is not cloud backup, it does not sync between devices, and clearing browser data deletes it. Your real backup is the exported files below, kept with the studio folder.

Last saved: —

Reset clears the local save and restores the original demo dataset.

Control Room Data Export (App Data Only — Not a Full Studio Backup)

Working

This export contains only what lives inside this app: the schema v2 data.json, CSV copies of the registers, and a restore README. It does not contain the studio folder, scripts, character portraits, production files or media — that complete backup is the separate panel below. The ZIP is built by a small ZIP writer inside this page (STORE format, no compression, no external library), so it works fully offline; if even that fails, the files are downloaded individually instead.

Restore accepts exactly the schema generate_data.py produces: schema_version: 2 with projects[] and characters[] arrays — the same schema this app exports, so the round-trip works both ways. Round-trip test: export the ZIP, then restore from it — the studio returns exactly as exported.

Full Studio Backup — The Complete Method

Manual

A complete studio backup — the whole NAS-STUDIO folder with scripts, character portraits, production files, clips and media — cannot be made from inside this web page: the browser has no access to the folder on disk. It is made on the owner's machine by the studio tool:

  1. Download export_studio.py below and place it in the NAS-STUDIO folder.
  2. Run python export_studio.py — it zips the entire folder (every department, script, portrait and media file) into 09-backups/studio-backup-YYYYMMDD.zip with a restore README inside.
  3. Keep that ZIP somewhere separate from the working folder (owner's device / Drive). That ZIP — not this app — is the full studio backup.

Restore procedure — full studio:

  1. Keep the backup ZIP untouched as the archive copy; work from a second copy.
  2. Unzip it anywhere — the full folder structure returns, readable without any app: registers are CSV/Markdown, characters are JSON + portrait images, clips are plain MP4.
  3. Run generate_data.py inside the restored folder to rebuild a fresh schema v2 data.json from the registers.
  4. To view it in the Control Room: open Data Vault → Restore and pick that data.json. The app validates schema_version 2 and the projects/characters arrays before replacing anything — a bad file changes nothing.
  5. After restore, check Master Control totals against the numbers written in the backup's README-RESTORE.md.
  6. The Operator Manual inside the folder explains every register, so a new operator or AI can run the studio from the files alone.

Restore Procedure — This App

Working
  1. Keep the export untouched as the archive copy; work from a second copy.
  2. Open the Control Room, go to Data Vault, choose the file under Restore (the data export ZIP or its data.json).
  3. The app validates the file (schema_version 2 + projects/characters arrays) before replacing anything — a bad file changes nothing.
  4. After restore, check Master Control totals against the numbers written in README-RESTORE.md.
  5. A restored state is saved locally like any other change, so it survives refresh on this device.
